purpose: Teach: 下巻/ストローク/ガイダンス/仕手/各論/持ち味/後発/自助

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 小説シリーズの下巻発売を発表しましょう
lines.en: Let's announce the second volume of the novel series.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Direct eye contact. Efficient pacing—someone moving through a clear agenda. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。テニス大会のストローク練習を企画しました
lines.en: Yes. I've planned the stroke-practice drills for the tennis tournament.
lines.style: Attentive and ready. Light nod implied in the voice. Matching her tempo but with warmth underneath—showing he's been thinking this through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新人向けガイダンスの内容を確定しましょう
lines.en: Let's finalize the content for the new-employee orientation.
lines.style: Measured directive. Same purposeful energy as before. Slightly firmer—ownership of the next item. Expects agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場で仕手筋の動きに警戒します
lines.en: Yes. I'll watch for speculator activity in the market.
lines.style: Steady and alert. Professional tone—this is a real concern he's noting. Slight weight on 'speculator activity' showing he understands the stakes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 提案書では各論を充実させましょう
lines.en: In the proposal, let's flesh out the individual points.
lines.style: Clear instruction. Lean forward slightly in the voice—detail matters here. Confident but not condescending. Building momentum through the meeting.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のお持ち味を生かす配置を考えます
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange positions that bring out each staff member's strengths.
lines.style: Thoughtful affirmation. Slower than his 'Yes' responses before—he's already thinking through people and placement. Genuine care in the pacing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 後発組として勝ち抜く戦略を立てましょう
lines.en: As a late entrant, let's build a strategy to break through.
lines.style: Decisive shift in tone—this is the pivot point. More intensity. Slight emphasis on 'break through'—this matters. Forward-facing energy.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の自助グループを支援します
lines.en: Yes. We'll support the customer self-help groups.
lines.style: Warm closure. Slower, more settled than previous responses. The closing 'yes' that signals alignment and readiness. Genuine support in the voice.
